title: consolida regalis subsp. divaricata
intro: Consolida regalis subsp. divaricata, commonly known as Larkspur or Rocket Larkspur, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The health benefits of Consolida regalis subsp. divaricata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, antispasmodic, and anticonvulsant properties, as well as its potential to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
